notes: Source: official Zaxcom Nomad User's Manual (published October 2018, software v8.01), hosted at zaxcom.com — covers the shared Nomad 8/10/12 chassis; items called out in the manual as "Nomad 8 and 12 only" (USB port, external USB storage/keyboard) are included since they apply to the 12. Several real connectors have no exact match in the allowed connector-id list, so the closest id was substituted and flagged in each port's note: TA-5 mini-XLR outputs/returns -> xlr5; the Hirose-4 power inlet -> xlr4-dc; the mini DB-15 (DE-15) AES3 digital I/O connector -> vga (same DE-15 shell, used here for audio not video); the SMA-female ZaxNet RF/antenna connector -> bnc. The single mini-DB15 AES connector carries 4 AES input pairs (one being AES42) and 3 AES output pairs simultaneously, modeled as one bidirectional port. No bandwidth grade applies to any port except the USB host port (explicitly spec'd as USB 2.0); all other connectors (XLR, TA5, TRS, BNC timecode, AES, Hirose power, RF antenna) are ungraded per the connector-type rules. CompactFlash card slots (primary + mirror) were omitted as storage media slots rather than signal/power connectors.

ports.name: Out 1/2
ports.note: Physical connector is TA-5M (mini-XLR 5-pin), closest listed id used; carries output buses 1 and 2.

ports.name: Ret 1/2
ports.note: TA-5 camera-return/line-level input pair (also usable as line inputs 7-8).

ports.name: Ret 3/4
ports.note: TA-5 camera-return/line-level input pair (also usable as line inputs 9-10).

ports.name: AES In/Out
ports.note: Physically a mini DB-15 (DE-15) connector carrying AES3 digital audio, not video; 4 AES input pairs (incl. 1 AES42 pair) + 3 AES output pairs share this single connector.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: Physical connector is a 4-pin Hirose (not XLR-shelled); accepts 10-18 VDC external power. xlr4-dc used as closest listed 4-pin locking DC connector id.

ports.name: ZaxNet
ports.note: Actual connector is SMA-female (2.4-2.475 GHz ZaxNet RF antenna, transmit or receive); no SMA id exists in the allowed list, BNC used as closest RF coax substitute.

ports.name: Serial
ports.note: USB-A shaped but wired as Zaxcom-proprietary RS-422 serial, not USB data; used to connect Zaxcom Oasis, FP8 fader panel, Mix-8 control panel, or GPI Remote Roll switch via adapter cables.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Nomad 8 and 12 only. Used for recording to USB drives or attaching a USB keyboard.
